title: Introduction to self-employment
competency: Explain self-employment and the skills needed for small businesses.

keywords.def: Working for yourself and earning income directly from buyers, rather than for an employer who pays a wage.
The ability to use one's knowledge effectively and readily in doing learned tasks.

en.text: Self-employment means working for yourself and earning income directly from the people who buy your goods or services, instead of being paid a wage by an employer. To succeed you need knowledge and skills. This unit covers three: reception skills, using and maintaining a photocopier, and running a small enterprise.
